observed_behavior: SC 4.1.2 Level A requires programmatic name/role, state/property/value and change notifications for user interface components in its stated scope.
context: Normative WCAG 2.2 Recommendation, 12 Dec 2024; criterion level/exception preserved
limitations: Does not mean every ordinary link requires application menubar/menuitem roles.
notes: SC text authority only; no site accessibility testing
